description: Airframe series number unknown. Marboré II engines; delivered to the FAS from Israel on 10 February 1974 and withdrawn after an accident at Ilopango on 22 April 1980. Displayed from 1993 at the entrance to the BACOM recreation area; where it stood until 21 February 2024. After structural maintenance and repainting in the "Torogoz" scheme it was re-erected on 31 August 2024 in the newly opened Plaza Bicentenario on Boulevard Luis Poma; Antiguo Cuscatlán. Note that in the course of this move its wingspan was cut down by roughly four metres; so the airframe as displayed is not complete. Photo credit Ricardo Alas. Most recent evidence: August 2024.
